url.description: The API endpoint URL to which the GET request is sent. This URL should be well-formed and include the protocol (e.g., 'https://').

startDate.description: The start date for the range filter in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-01-01'. Records generated earlier than this date are not considered.
